author: alvoron
title: PyTorch Detectron2 model-hub tests fail to download weights due to expired TLS certificate on dl.fbaipublicfiles.com
signature: ssl certificate verify failed certificate has expired|External Service

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Step 'PyTorch Detectron2 Tests' failed: all 19 detectron2 model-hub subtests fail downloading model weights.

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregator job fails because an upstream required job (PyTorch Models tests) failed.

key_errors:
E File ".../iopath/common/download.py", line 58, in download
E   tmp, _ = request.urlretrieve(url, filename=tmp, reporthook=hook(t))

E File "/usr/lib/python3.11/urllib/request.py", line 1364, in do_open
E   raise URLError(err)
E URLError: <urlopen error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: certificate has expired (_ssl.c:1018)>

root_cause: This is the second occurrence (within roughly 1.5 hours, on the same PR #39727 re-queued into the merge queue) of the same external-service failure first recorded at run 43121154399. All 19 Detectron2 precommit subtests again fail identically while downloading pretrained model weights (e.g. model_final_b275ba.pkl, model_final_68b088.pkl, model_final_bfca0b.pkl) via iopath's download() helper (test_detectron2.py -> detection_checkpoint.load -> iopath file_io.get_local_path -> download -> urllib.request.urlretrieve). The HTTPS handshake fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED: certificate has expired, confirming the TLS certificate on the external Detectron2 model-zoo host (dl.fbaipublicfiles.com) is still expired and has not yet been renewed since the prior run. This remains unrelated to the PR under test (cmake/dependencies.cmake, an oneTBB version bump for ARM MacOS) and unrelated to OpenVINO code; 3 in-process retries were attempted per model and all failed identically.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible via OpenVINO code changes. To reproduce locally: run `python3 -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_detectron2.py -m precommit -v` against a built OpenVINO install and observe the same URLError when the harness tries to download any detectron2 model checkpoint from its hosted model zoo URL while the external host's certificate remains expired.
recommended_actions: Monitor the external Detectron2 model-zoo host's certificate; this will keep recurring until the third party renews it.
Re-run only the failed jobs or re-queue the PR once the certificate is renewed (automatic remediation requested for this run).

Since this is now a 2nd occurrence for the same PR in a short window, consider temporarily skipping/quarantining the Detectron2 precommit suite in the merge queue until the external certificate is fixed, to avoid repeatedly blocking this and other PRs.
Consider caching/mirroring Detectron2 reference weights internally to decouple CI from this external host's certificate lifecycle.
prevention_strategies: Model-hub tests that fetch artifacts from third-party hosts should treat TLS/connectivity failures to those hosts as infrastructure flakiness, not code regressions, and should avoid blocking unrelated PRs' merges when triggered purely by expired external certificates. Consider a dedicated 'external model download' health check or cached mirror to decouple from host certificate lifecycle, plus faster escalation when the same PR is bounced by the same external failure repeatedly.
historical_context: Identical failure (same signature_hash 2641a2995515ec82) was previously recorded ~1.5 hours earlier at run https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/actions/runs/43121154399, also on PR #39727. This is now a recurring pattern (2nd occurrence) tied to the same external host certificate issue, not a one-off blip.
